features.title: Monte Carlo transport
features.description: IMC/DDMC particle transport. CPU builds transport serially per rank; STORM_WITH_GPU builds transport on Kokkos' default execution space: the GPU with a device Kokkos, OpenMP threads with a host-only Kokkos.

subfeatures.title: Source emission
subfeatures.description: Emitted on the transport's execution space when the physics supports device source generation.

subfeatures.title: Comb population control
subfeatures.description: Activation on the transport's execution space; the shuffle runs on the host.

subfeatures.title: Census and energy tallies
subfeatures.description: Accumulated on the transport's execution space; the census is copied back on the host.

subfeatures.title: DDMC
subfeatures.description: On the device in GPU builds while RadiationIMCParameters::ddmcGpuEnable is set (the default).

subfeatures.title: Compton, polarization, observers, post-processing, tracing
subfeatures.description: Physics that forces the whole transport back to the host (IMCDeviceExecutor eligibility checks).

rules.message: STORM falls back to host transport for Compton, polarization, observers, post-processing and tracing runs.
